note: Email normalization preserves generated and mailbox-token copies, all explicitly contact. Geographic country codes use the ISO vocabulary; free-form address components remain contact fields. UUIDs are relational metadata retained for referential/financial integrity, not an instruction to export identifiers. Customer authentication is separate from staff: mailbox proof/session tokens and PHC credentials are hashes only, global/IP limiter stores opaque admission digests without tenant ownership. Verified guest-order links are the identity-authority path for guest records after mailbox proof.

structures.Argon2idPHC: Argon2id PHC password hash envelope (parameters, salt and digest), never plaintext credentials; not exportable.
structures.CustomerAuthAdmissionDigest: Opaque 32-byte keyed account or IP-prefix admission hash; global counter key is a fixed digest sentinel. No raw email/IP is stored in limit tables.
structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte SHA-256 capability digest; raw verification/reset/session tokens are never persisted.
